headline: RubyCoder.ai: A Professional Network for the Ruby Community Launches
summary: A new platform aims to centralize Ruby gems, developer tools, and technical content, including emerging AI technologies, for the Ruby ecosystem.
details: RubyCoder.ai has launched as a dedicated professional network and resource platform for the Ruby developer community. Unlike general developer platforms, it focuses exclusively on Ruby and its associated technologies, aiming to simplify the discovery of gems, tools, and knowledge.

The platform organizes Ruby gems and developer resources by area of software development, allowing developers to explore libraries based on their building needs rather than knowing specific gem names. This is particularly beneficial for discovering new tools in emerging areas.

RubyCoder.ai also emphasizes Ruby's growing role in the AI ecosystem. It highlights Ruby libraries and resources for LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, RAG, AI APIs, and agents, enabling developers to build AI-powered applications without leaving their existing stack.

Beyond tools and gems, the platform aggregates technical articles and guides on Ruby development, AI engineering, and relevant modern technologies. This provides a comprehensive learning path from discovering a technology to understanding its implementation and related tools.

The core mission of RubyCoder.ai is to create a focused environment where developers, open-source projects, gems, and technical knowledge within the Ruby ecosystem can connect. It aims to be the go-to place for anyone working with Ruby, Rails, or exploring its AI capabilities.

headline_marked: Apple to unveil [[foldable iPhone Ultra]] next week
headline: Apple to unveil foldable iPhone Ultra next week
summary: The highly anticipated foldable iPhone Ultra is expected to be revealed at Apple's September event, with release timing to follow.
details: Apple is reportedly set to unveil its first foldable iPhone, dubbed the "iPhone Ultra," at its upcoming September event. This marks a significant move for the company into the foldable smartphone market.

While the exact release date for the iPhone Ultra is not yet confirmed, sources suggest it will be announced next week. Further details regarding its availability and pricing are expected to be revealed during the event.

The foldable iPhone Ultra is anticipated to feature a unique design, differentiating it from existing foldable phones. Specific technical specifications and features are yet to be officially disclosed by Apple.

This launch comes at a time when the foldable phone market is experiencing steady growth, with several manufacturers already offering their own devices. Apple's entry is expected to further legitimize and boost the segment.
